name: v12-mirror
description: Exact frozen v12 self-play control to measure starting-side effects.

name: grok-leash-healing-front
description: v12 dribbles healthy fighters onto the payload while wounded peel off, so the army dies in detail; the proven counter is a 3-miner 4-9 medic mix whose fighters wait at 4.5 path-leash from a medic whenever an enemy fighter is in range, with idle medics distributed instead of stacking on the payload-closest ally. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: grok-healer-hunter
description: v12 never prioritize-fires medics and only fields battles/5 of them unless it sees a 4-healer or 2-healer-with-thin-front army; cap ourselves at 2 medics and 3 miners with 8+ fighters so their support flag stays off, then all exposed shots prefer healers so the remaining isolated fighters cannot recover. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: grok-triple-hold-crush
description: v12 assigns one capture guard and that guard is not a contester while rallying, so a wounded support-mode holder walks off the disc; park three shortest-path fighters on capture who ignore rally, and field four medics so v12 enters support and its lone guard peels at 60% HP while overlapping fire cycles delete whoever stays. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: grok-staged-army-wave
description: v12 and the failed first counters feed freshly spawned fighters onto the payload one-by-one into a formed enemy; hold on our deposit-side until 8 fighters and 4 healers exist (or tick 2200 / home raid), then release the whole wave so the first contact is a blob instead of a trickle. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: grok-splash-clump-fire
description: once v12 sees four of our healers its ally repulsion drops to 0.5 and every idle medic stacks on the payload-closest fighter, forming splash clumps; keep our own spacing at 3.0, field 4+ medics to force that mode, and aim at the densest exposed hull instead of nearest. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: grok-threshold-peel
description: support-mode v12 retreats fighters at 60% HP and the capture guard only contests when rally is none, so four visible medics put them in that mode while we focus the disc occupant to two shots (HP<=4) and refuse to peel ourselves unless a one-hit would kill us; their holder walks off, ours stay, payload flips after the combat collapse they already showed on side B. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: fable-splash-cluster
description: v12 drops its own spacing repulsion from 3.0 to 0.5 whenever it currently sees 4+ enemy healers, so its fighters and stacked healers bunch inside splash radius. Field and keep 4 healers early, keep our own spacing at full strength, pick targets by how many enemies sit within splash of them, and always run the hit-maximizing aim search (not only when the primary target is blocked). Leash and 3 guards keep us alive while splash does the work. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: fable-wounded-finisher
description: v12 support-mode fighters retreat at <=60% HP and come back the moment they cross 6 HP, so its front line is permanently two hits from death and its retreaters walk only 1.8 units behind the line. Target exposed enemies by lowest health regardless of economy, and extend engagement reach 40% for targets at or below two hits so retreaters are chased and killed instead of healed back. Supported ball (3 guards, leash, escorts) keeps our own line alive. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: fable-healer-hunter
description: Once v12 sees 4 healers it builds medics up to two-thirds of its fighters (max 12): unarmed bots that all park 1.8 units behind the same payload-nearest fighter. Killing that medic line turns every v12 retreat into a walk to nowhere and leaves 6-HP fighters unhealed. Priority: exposed one-hit kills, then exposed healers, then by health; fighters pursue healers out to 1.5x range for flanking firing positions. Supported ball underneath. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: fable-econ-attrition-ball
description: The match against v12 is decided by 4000 ticks of attrition at the payload, where replacement rate wins. v12 fixes itself at 3 miners; six miners double token income (an extra rush bot every ~170 ticks) while the 32-slot cap makes the early slot cost trivial. v12 answers 6+ miners with weakest-targeting and lowest-health triage, which the leashed, escorted, half-healer ball absorbs; it never raids our deposit. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: fable-cohesion-groups
description: In support mode v12 never uses regroup_position, so every healthy fighter and every reinforcement walks to the payload alone and gets focus-fired on arrival. Counter with fighter-to-fighter cohesion instead of a medic leash: a fighter with fewer than two allied fighters within heal range joins the nearest fighter that already has two, guards excepted, so we always engage as concentrated groups against v12 trickle. Escort-distributed healers give each group its own medic; wounded fighters still retreat at 60%. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.

name: fable-cooldown-kiter
description: The supported opponent engages at 0.8 range with nearest targeting and its fighters leash to healers, so it must walk into our fire to shoot. Fighters fire at 0.95 range, then back off half a range while their blaster is on cooldown and re-approach when ready, so each exchange trades our full-cooldown shot for a partial one of theirs. Healers always tuck behind their patient (not only when support is detected) and we field healers at one per three fighters so kiters that take chip damage recover between exchanges. Full-v12-source counter; shared roster knobs unused.
